notes.title: Dyed In White is now available to wishlist!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/54ae1bd865d11d2ccae94b13e509d316dcbb12cb.png[/img]
Hello, everyone!

We’re delighted to reveal our next upcoming release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3536260/Dyed_in_White/}]Dyed In White[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3536260/Dyed_in_White/

A laid-back NTR RPG with a thrilling story and multiple endings. As Hayato, pursue becoming a Holy Knight alongside beautiful Leia. Delve into her deepest thoughts and shield her from other men. Can you protect her purity in a world full of temptation?

Should you enjoy our games, consider joining us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/EaqZEsP3pV]Discord[/url] and following our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Saikey]Steam Publisher Page[/url] for all the latest news from Saikey Studios!
